PDL-CAS-26-015, Proposed Regional Procedural By-law
notes:
Regional Clerk, Tim Brubacher, provided an introduction to the report.

Committee discussed the merits of deferring this report and proposed changes of the procedure by-law until the mandate letter of the new Chair has been seen by Council.

Committee inquired into if the by-law changes are time sensitive. T. Brubacher explained that the only time sensitive portion of the by-law is to ensure an Acting Chair by-law be in place, in case the province does not appoint a Chair by November 15th.

T. Brubacher also explained that regardless of the procedure by-law the changes proposed are already present in the Municipal Act and that the Act supersedes the procedure by-law. T. Brubacher also confirmed that an Acting Chair would not have Strong Chair powers.

Committee inquired on how often the procedure by-law is brought back for updates. T. Brubacher confirmed that updates are usually brought forward in the third or fourth year of a Council term.

Committee expressed interest in the new term of Council receiving training on the new legislation changes during Council Orientation in November 2026.

Committee also requested that information on these legislation changes be provided to residents in plain language. Clerks staff can work with Communications staff on a communique.

items.title: CAO-EDI-26-003, Grand River Accessibility Advisory Committee Updates
notes:
CAO, Darshpreet Bhatti, introduced the report.

Committee inquired into why staff are recommending the removal of term limits for citizen members. Accessibility Lead, Haley Gienow-McConnell, explained that the Region is looking to ensure that a variety of voices are at the table to discuss accessibility matters. 

Committee inquired into Regional staff could advertise positions for the Committee on social media so that area municipalities and Councillors could share with their residents directly. H. Gienow-McConnell, committed to a range of advertising to reach residents.

Committee inquired into how collaboration will now look between the Region and area municipalities will occur. Staff confirmed that they are working with accessibility staff at all the area municipalities to see what collaboration and communication will look like moving forward.

Committee inquired into how to ensure township participation is maintained. Committee considered and discussed an amendment to have a minimum requirement of representation from the townships. 

Committee inquired into what the budget for the Committee will cover. Staff explained that the budget covers things like honorariums, travel costs, and ASL interpreters.

items.title: Councillor S. Shantz
notes:
Councillor Shantz brought forward a motion in regards to the Woolwich Community Health Centre and requesting the Region provide a grant to the centre to cover the development charges for their recent expansion. Committee discussed how this request would be precedent setting, as well as how there is no funding source for this request; if approved, the funds would need to be pulled from the tax levy.

Committee also discussed a deferral of this request to the 2027 budget process as a potential add-on item.

motions.text: WHEREAS Woolwich Community Health Centre (WCHC) is a long standing local community governed not-for-profit charity that provides comprehensive primary health care and community support to over 28,000 residents of Waterloo Region, and; WHEREAS the rural population has more than 8,000 residents with no family doctor, and; WHEREAS WCHC has attached over 2,400 patients across local municipalities to a primary care provider and is working to increase access for roughly 6,000 more through the current expansion, and; WHEREAS the Regional portion of the Development Charges on the expansion project have been assessed at $81,681.86, and the Township of Woolwich has provided a grant of $35, 925.06, equal to their portion of development charges; THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Region of Waterloo provide a grant to WCHC in the amount of $81,681.86 to cover the Regional costs associated with the expansion.
